> **Mandatory handoff:** Before opening or continuing a PR, check [the central development ledger on main](../docs/LU_DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md), the original tool-domain scope, and current open PR heads. Do not overwrite or reimplement equivalent work on another branch. If stacked, explicitly name the base PR and retarget to `main` after prerequisites merge. Keep in-progress receipts in this PR body; only the owner/integration pass updates manual accepted status in the central ledger. The active-PR inventory there is regenerated automatically and is metadata only.
